title: Normalize Sourcing Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize sourcing/plugin/rs/** to the Consistency Contract: adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/resolve_labels/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled SourcingLabels struct + resolver and manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; adopt SDK CommandLabels helper (localized_label_map); adopt SDK Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry) replacing local test scaffolding; fix region markers (rename 🔖️Bundle to 🔖️Manifest, rename 🔖️Tests to 🧪️Tests) and reorder into canonical shape; verify C1 naming (SourcingCurateApp for app id sourcing-curate) and resource_kind declarations are already conformant. PanelKit adoption skipped (crate has no tree_item/PanelTreeBuilder usage — it renders tables and world3d scenes, not trees).
summary: Normalized sourcing/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. Adopted SDK Terminology (app_labels! macro + resolve_labels + is_de_locale, replacing the hand-rolled SourcingLabels struct/EN-DE consts/resolver fn), SDK CommandLabels helper (localized_label_map, dropping the hand-rolled (id,en,de)->HashMap loop and the now-unnecessary sourcing_utility_labels stub), and AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (replacing the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal in app_labels(); empty fields like panel_tab_labels/utility_labels are simply omitted from the chain now). Adopted SDK Testkit (semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry), removing the local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() scaffolding and calling testkit::* directly at each call site; app-specific test bodies were left untouched since none matched the generic undo-redo/convergence/idempotency shapes verbatim. Fixed region markers: renamed Bundle region to Manifest (merging the former Layout region's window/stack/layout builders into it alongside hidden_op/create_sourcing_curate_app/sourcing_setup/semio_plugin!, matching cad-plugin's precedent of layout builders living in Manifest), renamed the Tests region marker from the bookmark emoji to the test-tube emoji, and reordered regions to Constants -> Contributions -> Document -> Terminology -> Panels -> World3d -> SourcingCurateApp -> CommandLabels -> Manifest -> Tests. C1 naming verified already conformant (app id "sourcing-curate" -> struct SourcingCurateApp; whole-crate grep found zero residue of any other name, no rename needed). resource_kind declarations (catalogue.kinds, catalogue.sourcing) verified already present and correct. PanelKit adoption skipped: crate has no tree_item/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids usage (renders table + world3d scenes only). Verification: rustfmt --check against the repo's rustfmt.toml (max_width=250) shows zero new violations vs the pre-edit snapshot (11 pre-existing formatting diffs, identical count/content class to the original file, none inside code I actually wrote); brace/paren balance confirmed; exhaustive grep cross-reference of every renamed/removed identifier found zero residue. A `cargo check -p sourcing-plugin --lib` was started but produced no output after several minutes due to the documented repo-wide cargo lock contention (20+ concurrent cargo processes observed) - left running in background, not confirmed compiling; this is the one item deferred to the orchestrator's final full-workspace gate.
